evaluators.description: oci_identity_authentication_policy.password_policy.0.is_lowercase_characters_required must be true. It is a boolean attribute, so Equals true rather than IsNotEmpty; error_tolerance 1 means an absent password_policy block, or a block without the flag, is a severity-2 attribute miss and still fails.
